meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 处理天文数据与物理量计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Python做天文数据处理或模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Process astronomical data and physical quantities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with astronomical data or simulations in Python.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 Astropy 库处理天文数据，比如转换天体坐标、换算单位、读写 FITS 文件、做宇宙学计算、处理时间、操作表格和图像坐标变换。
howto.when: 当你需要分析天文数据，比如转换坐标、换算单位、读写 FITS 文件、做宇宙学计算或处理时间时，Claude 会自动调用 Astropy 来帮你。

say.text: 把赤道坐标 (10.5°, 41.2°) 转换成银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会用 SkyCoord 进行坐标转换。

say.text: 读取 observation.fits 文件并显示图像数据统计。
计算红移 1.5 的光度距离和宇宙年龄。
say.note: Claude 会用 Planck18 宇宙学模型计算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Astropy library to handle astronomical data: convert celestial coordinates, convert units, read/write FITS files, perform cosmological calculations, handle time, manipulate tables, and transform image coordinates.
howto.when_en: When you need to analyze astronomical data, such as converting coordinates, converting units, reading/writing FITS files, performing cosmological calculations, or handling time, Claude will automatically use Astropy to help.

say_en.text: Convert equatorial coordinates (10.5°, 41.2°) to galactic coordinates.
say_en.note: Claude will use SkyCoord for coordinate transformation.

say_en.text: Read observation.fits and show image data statistics.
say_en.note: Claude will use fits.open to read and compute mean/median.

say_en.text: Calculate luminosity distance and universe age at redshift 1.5.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Planck18 cosmology model.
